WITH months AS ( SELECT d::date AS ms, to_char(d, 'YYYY-MM') AS period FROM generate_series(#{fromMonth}::date, #{toMonth}::date, interval '1 month') AS d ), units AS (
SELECT p.tenant_id, p.community_id, p.parking_id AS unit_id, coalesce(p.usage_type, '未知') AS usage_type, 1::numeric AS quantity FROM parking p WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT h.tenant_id, h.community_id, h.house_id AS unit_id, coalesce(h.usage_type, '未知') AS usage_type, 1::numeric AS quantity FROM house h WHERE h.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT NULL::bigint AS tenant_id, NULL::varchar AS community_id, NULL::varchar AS unit_id, NULL::varchar AS usage_type, NULL::numeric AS quantity WHERE 1 = 0
SELECT h.tenant_id, h.community_id, h.house_id AS unit_id, coalesce(h.usage_type, '未知') AS usage_type, h.build_area AS quantity FROM house h WHERE h.deleted_at IS NULL
) SELECT m.period AS period, u.usage_type AS usage, count(DISTINCT u.unit_id) AS houses, count(*) FILTER (WHERE pr.price IS NULL) AS gaps, coalesce(sum(round(u.quantity * pr.price, 2)) FILTER (WHERE pr.price IS NOT NULL), 0) AS receivable FROM units u CROSS JOIN months m LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT p.price FROM fee_item_price p WHERE p.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND p.community_id = u.community_id AND p.item_id = #{itemId} AND p.biz_type = u.usage_type AND p.effective_from <= m.ms AND (p.effective_to IS NULL OR p.effective_to >= m.ms) ORDER BY p.effective_from DESC LIMIT 1 ) pr ON true
u.unit_id IS NOT NULL
AND u.community_id = #{communityId}
GROUP BY m.period, u.usage_type ORDER BY m.period, u.usage_type

SELECT coalesce(sum(a.amount) FILTER ( WHERE btrim(b.period) >= #{fromPeriod} AND btrim(b.period) <= #{toPeriod}), 0) AS current, coalesce(sum(a.amount) FILTER (WHERE btrim(b.period) < #{fromPeriod}), 0) AS clearing, coalesce(sum(a.amount) FILTER (WHERE btrim(b.period) > #{toPeriod}), 0) AS prepaid, coalesce(sum(a.amount) FILTER (WHERE b.period IS NULL), 0) AS no_period, coalesce(sum(a.amount), 0) AS total FROM payment_allocation a JOIN payment p ON p.id = a.payment_id AND p.status = '正常' AND p.method <> '预存抵扣' AND p.paid_at >= #{fromTs} AND p.paid_at < #{toTs} LEFT JOIN bill b ON b.id = a.bill_id JOIN fee_item f ON f.id = a.item_id WHERE f.item_code = #{itemCode}
AND p.community_id = #{communityId}
